summary: Tested Preview quick-print/PDF flows for vehicle details. Backend document generation and workshop data mapping passed; frontend quick-print dialog behavior is inconsistent from the dropdown and prevented full deterministic UI verification for invoice/diagnosis/visit-print in one stable run.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking quick print actions is inconsistent in Preview (dialog sometimes does not open, and when opened once for invoice it showed neither preview nor explicit error after wait).

integration_issues.issue: Could not reliably validate full UI output content in one stable pass because dropdown-triggered dialog opening/preview state was intermittent in browser automation despite authenticated session.

action_items: Stabilize VehicleDetails quick-print menu interaction so invoice/quote/diagnosis clicks always open QuickPrintDialog (not hover-fragile).
Ensure QuickPrintDialog always transitions from loading to either preview iframe or visible error state for invoice flow.
Re-test visit-card print button flow after UI stabilization to confirm consistent preview generation.
Keep backend mapping as-is: /api/documents/generate currently includes workshop legal/contact fields and vehicle context correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend doc generation path is healthy: authenticated /api/documents/generate returned HTML containing ورشة عبدالله الكبير, 0553280100, 1131051365, invoice/diagnosis titles, and vehicle context in pytest.
VehicleDetails quick-print dropdown uses hover-dependent menu (`hidden group-hover:block`), which is a likely source of flaky click/open behavior under real usage and automation.
Observed repeated 401 noise for unrelated assistant endpoints in browser console; not blocking this print feature but adds console noise during verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression for quick-print payload and document generation is green (4/4). Frontend login and vehicle navigation worked. Main blocker is inconsistent quick-print dialog opening/rendering from VehicleDetails dropdown, so run manual + Playwright retest specifically on dropdown-to-dialog transitions and visit-print button after UI fix.
rca of the issue: RCA (current run): issue appears frontend-interaction/state related, not backend document generation. Reproduction in Preview: open vehicle details -> use top print menu -> invoice/diagnosis click may not consistently produce dialog/preview; one invoice run yielded dialog without preview/error state after wait, and diagnosis open timed out. Probable cause is hover-only dropdown interaction + timing/state race in QuickPrintDialog lifecycle. Mitigation: make print menu click-driven (not hover-only), then verify QuickPrintDialog always resolves to preview or explicit error.
